deviations_from_paper.explanation: Whitespace-insensitive character F1 against the generator's own text, which is exact by construction. Precision and recall are equal, so the extractor neither dropped text nor invented any.
Each ground-truth paragraph is searched in the extracted stream at or after the previous hit. A column interleave fails this even when every word is present.
Cell-by-cell comparison of the reconstructed matrix against the generated table; exact match means every cell landed in its row and column.
Share of emitted blocks with a four-number bounding box whose x-range is well formed.
The repeating header and the centred page number must not appear in the running text; the page number is the harder case because it sits inside the column gutter.

deviations_from_paper.reference_value: the abstract text published in the arXiv metadata for RoBERTa (arXiv 1907.11692)
deviations_from_paper.explanation: Fraction of the publisher's abstract word-trigrams present in the extracted text. Word order is preserved by trigrams, so interleaved columns or dropped lines lower it. Residual gap is mostly line-break hyphenation and ligature spelling.
The largest-font block in the front matter is the title; compared against the arXiv metadata title.

deviations_from_paper.target: scanned:honest status instead of fabricated text
deviations_from_paper.reference_value: status partial, page flagged for OCR, zero text blocks
deviations_from_paper.explanation: An image-only page has no text layer. Emitting anything for it would be invention; the check requires the page to be flagged and the block list to stay empty.

envelope.note: Two-column ACM/ACL layout and single-column arXiv layout.
Column detection scales with the modal font size.
Base-14 Courier, pdfTeX Type1 subsets with /Differences, WinAnsi, and Identity-H style CID fonts with /ToUnicode are all handled by the decoder.
13-page paper parses in about 1.2 s on a single core, stdlib only.

failure_modes.condition: page has no text layer (scan / image-only)
failure_modes.symptom: status partial, page listed in ocr_required_pages, blocks empty
characters become U+FFFD and unknown_glyph_ratio rises; status turns partial above 2%

failure_modes.condition: table whose cells are not separated by visible whitespace
failure_modes.symptom: no table reported for that region; text stays in a paragraph block

failure_modes.condition: rotated text (arXiv side stamp, vertical axis label)
failure_modes.symptom: excluded from reading order and counted in rotated_text_runs
status failed, no document catalog found; no password guessing

sensitivity.outcome_range: a narrower band misses a low footer; a wider band eats the first body line on dense pages. 0.08 plus the 'repeated text' rule is what the fixture checks.
below ~0.5 em a justified paragraph's word gaps become candidate gutters; above ~1.5 em a tight two-column gutter is missed.

sensitivity.outcome_metric: table rows rejoined across split regions
sensitivity.outcome_range: tighter than 1 pt fails to rejoin rows set on a baseline shift; looser than 4 pt starts merging neighbouring paragraph lines.

reference_inputs.twocolumn-synthetic: generated by scripts/pdffixtures.py, exact ground truth
reference_inputs.scanned: rasterised from the synthetic page, no text layer by construction
